captions.intro: One of the most-used libraries on Earth had quite a year. Let's look.
captions.commits: Active on 183 days so far. Somebody was always shipping.
captions.people: From one-time fixers to people who basically live here.
captions.lines: Net +134,215 lines. About 121,000 of them arrived in one commit.
captions.months: February was the busiest month of the year.
captions.hours: Peak hour: 1 PM. React gets built right after lunch.
captions.weekdays: Midweek is for merging. Weekends are (mostly) for resting.
captions.streak: A full week of commits in January, and never more than 6 days off.
captions.calendar: November 12: a dozen DevTools dependency upgrades, one after another.
captions.languages: Rust came within 2 points of JavaScript. In a JavaScript library.
captions.files: The file where React meets the real DOM. Touched 40 times.
captions.biggest: June 9: the React Compiler, ported to Rust in one commit.
captions.messages: 113 commit messages mention DevTools. It's the year's favourite word.
captions.personality: Commit messages average 67 characters, with tags and PR numbers. Future readers are grateful.
captions.outro: That was React's 2026. Now make your own.
